notes: Weather is now a proper face rather than a list: a large icon beside a large temperature, with today's high and low and the town underneath. Sized against the clock face so the two read as a matched pair instead of competing for the same…
The icon is drawn from geometry rather than a picture, so it stays sharp at the larger size on any display scaling. All three icon sets work at that size.

Temperature and sky no longer repeat as rows underneath — the face already shows both, and saying it twice in the space of an inch wasted the room the readings needed. What remains below is what the face has no space for: feels-like…
Content amount still applies: Minimal is the face on its own, Relaxed adds two readings, Dense adds all three.
